description:
One of your folders and its items, newest filed first, limit 1 to 100 a page (page
    with next_cursor). Each item has item_id, note, thumbnail_url, title and the full hook
    or find object. Same as GET /v1/folders/{folder_id}. Free. Errors: 404
    folder_not_found.

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name: get_folder
